summary: Bant extra-spell counters: Bumbleflower grows the team and draws two on the second spell, while opponents keep the extra cards.

tags.name: +1/+1 counters
tags.reason: Bumbleflower, Ouroboroid, Kami, Ozolith, Dusk Legion Duelist, and Triumph close through counters rather than a separate combo.

tags.name: draw
tags.reason: The commander, second-draw creatures, Trouble in Pairs, Wizard Class, and hug taxes all convert extra cards into the plan.

tags.name: commander matters
tags.reason: Crime land, Loki draws, flying until end of turn, and the second-spell draw all key off Bumbleflower staying in play.

tags.name: control
tags.reason: A real counter suite plus two sweepers and cheap removal, pointed at protecting the engine rather than a lock.

tags.name: flash
tags.reason: High Fae Trickster, Final-Word Phantom, Seedborn Muse, and several flash creatures spend mana on other turns.

tags.name: group hug
tags.reason: Bumbleflower, gift spells, Faerie Mastermind, Gleaming Splendor, Selvala, and Tataru donate cards or mana as the cost of the engine.

tags.name: midrange
tags.reason: The list wins by growing a board over several turns, not by a two-card combo or a turn-three kill.

tags.name: politics
tags.reason: Gift counters, Promise of Loyalty, and who receives Bumbleflower's card are real choices, not the win.

tags.name: proliferate
tags.reason: Dreamtide Whale and Ripples of Potential spread counters; the deck still functions without them.

tags.name: spellslinger
tags.reason: Casting two spells a turn is the engine, but the payoffs are creatures and counters, not a storm kill.

tags.name: tokens
tags.reason: Zenith, Aligned Heart, Jolrael, Minn, Broodscale, and Messenger make tokens, but they support counters rather than a token anthem plan.

tags.name: blink
tags.reason: Whitemane Lion and Aang interact with the battlefield; there is no ETB-blink core.

tags.name: infect
tags.reason: Triumph of the Hordes is the listed closer, not an infect creature package.
